changes.title: Keep missing combat details with the correct event
changes.text: Stop detail lookup at later combat events or recording gaps so missing identities remain unknown instead of becoming another enemy or boss.

changes.title: Check missing attack damage and kill details
changes.text: Retain complete controls, missing-event cases and cache rebuilding without changing raw history.

changes.title: Record completed provenance checks and continued audit
changes.text: Preserve actual source verification and new component reviews while distinguishing pending checks from completed work.

commentary: I corrected how incomplete combat records are associated so statistics do not borrow another enemy's identity. Raw history remains intact, and the full UIMSD audit is still underway.
